fields.description: A Copilot run starts for every new ticket of a customer with "Copilot enabled"
fields.label: Enabled

fields.description: Tasks for hand-overs go here when the customer has no project of their own
fields.label: Hand-over Project

fields.description: Copilot investigates and notes its diagnosis for the team only: the customer sees no stages, no hand-over tasks are created, and agents rate each diagnosis. Switch off only after the ratings show Copilot is right often enough.
fields.label: Shadow mode

fields.description: A worker keeps a run alive by heartbeat; after this long without one the run is given back to the queue
fields.label: Lease Minutes

fields.description: After this many lost leases the run fails and a person is told
fields.label: Max Lease Losses

fields.description: An investigation below this confidence (0 to 1) is treated as unclear
fields.label: Min Confidence

fields.description: TBO staff and the Copilot worker use the hub's MCP server (helpdesk.api.copilot_mcp.handle)
fields.label: MCP Server On

fields.description: Per person; calls over this are refused for the rest of the minute
fields.label: MCP Calls per Minute

fields.description: Who may approve a Copilot fix. Changes to sensitive areas need a senior; with no senior in the list, Agent Managers act as seniors
fields.label: Approvers

fields.description: Put on every Copilot pull request until the hub merges it; the org merge bot and the auto-merge workflow skip pull requests with this label
fields.label: Hold Label

fields.description: Copilot fixes a diagnosed bug itself: it reproduces it on a sandbox copy of the site, changes the code until its check passes, and opens the pull request for the one approval. Off: only when an agent presses Let Copilot fix it.
fields.label: Copilot writes fixes

fields.description: How often Copilot may try to fix the same run (a lost worker counts as a try).
fields.label: Fix attempts per run

fields.description: The worker stops a fix that would cost more than this, in US dollars (0: no cap).
fields.label: Dollar cap per fix

fields.description: Build with Copilot on a customization whose written scope the customer approved (Phase 8). Off: customizations go to a developer.
fields.label: Copilot Builds Approved Customizations

fields.description: Copilot builds estimates up to this many hours; bigger ones go to a developer.
fields.label: Max Build Hours

fields.description: The AI budget of one build. Blank: twice the dollar cap per fix.
fields.label: Dollar cap per build

fields.description: Copilot's commits carry this email. When every commit of a pull request does, the customer's developer may approve it.
fields.label: Copilot commit email

fields.description: The TBO Copilot GitHub App. With its id and private key, TBO Support uses a short-lived key per repository (and gives the worker one to push a fix) instead of the personal token in Settings, GitHub.
fields.label: GitHub App ID

fields.description: The App's private key: paste the whole .pem file's text. The box keeps one line, so its line breaks are lost; that is fine.
fields.label: GitHub App private key

fields.description: TBO's Press, for example https://tbocloud.in. Copilot deploys merged fixes through it.
fields.label: Press URL

fields.description: The API key of Copilot's own Press user in TBO's Press team.
fields.label: Press API key

fields.description: Copilot's team on Press, when its user belongs to more than one (sent as X-Press-Team).
fields.label: Press team

fields.description: Deploy Tonight goes out from this time (HH:MM, in the timezone below).
fields.label: Deploy window starts

fields.description: How long a deploy waits for Press (another deploy running, the merged commit not yet on the bench) before it moves to the next window.
fields.label: Wait for Press (minutes)

fields.description: How long the check after a deploy may take before it counts as failed.
fields.label: Check after deploy (minutes)

fields.description: Test benches only. Press then updates the sites without taking a backup first, so a failed update cannot be restored from one. Leave it off for customers' live sites.
fields.label: Skip Press's backup

fields.description: Root-cause categories or risk levels whose approved fixes deploy in the window without anyone pressing Deploy, one per line. Empty in the pilot.
fields.label: Auto-deploy categories

fields.description: One row per stage; a missing or empty row uses the built-in text
fields.label: Stage Messages
Pilot
fields.description: Phase 4: how far Copilot may go per customer, the monthly AI budget, and the weekly pilot email (docs/tbo-copilot.md, Pilot).

fields.label: Default Copilot level
fields.description: For customers whose Copilot level is blank. Diagnose only: the team sees the diagnosis, the customer nothing. Explain: the customer sees the stages and the explanations agents send. Fix: Copilot also writes fixes. Correct: a senior may also approve setting and data corrections. Shadow mode holds everyone at Diagnose only.

fields.label: Monthly AI budget (USD)
fields.description: What Copilot's runs may cost in a calendar month. At 80% the Agent Managers are told; at 100% no new work goes to a worker until the next month or a larger budget. 0: no budget.

fields.label: Dollar cap per diagnosis
fields.description: The worker stops an investigation that would cost more than this, in US dollars (0: the worker's own limit).

fields.label: Weekly pilot email to
fields.description: Email addresses, one per line or comma separated, besides the Agent Managers. Sent on Monday at 08:00 Riyadh time with last week's numbers.

fields.label: Teams bot
fields.description: Phase 6: the TBO Copilot bot in Teams (an Azure Bot registered by TBO's Microsoft 365 admin). Its messaging endpoint is /api/method/helpdesk.api.copilot_teams.messages on this site.

fields.label: Teams bot enabled
fields.description: Off: Teams messages go through the Workflows webhooks of HD Chat Settings, as before.

fields.label: Bot app ID
fields.description: The Microsoft App ID of the Azure Bot (single tenant).

fields.label: Tenant ID
fields.description: Blank: the Microsoft tenant ID in HD Settings.
Phase 7: every merge into a branch a customer site runs goes out through TBO Support: CI, one approval, the Press deploy in the window, the check after (docs/tbo-copilot.md, Releases).
fields.label: Releases

fields.description: One owner/repo per line. Only these repositories' branches become releases; add a repository once its CI is green.
fields.label: Repositories in the pipeline

fields.description: The customer's UAT site when a card runs the branch there, else the sandbox check by a worker. Off: releases go straight to their approval.
fields.label: Stage before the approval

fields.description: After this, the check is marked not run and a senior decides whether the release goes on.
fields.label: Hours a sandbox check may wait for a worker
